recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if a current generated StructureDefinition snapshot omits inherited Resource or DomainResource elements.
issue_request: FHIR-5535 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 request asking that JSON resource profile definitions include the common elements and attributes shared by all resources.
initial_application: Jira comments say the DSTU1 profile-generation problem was sorted after profile work in 2015. No source-changing FHIR-5535 commit was found on the combined branch; the current source later adopted active Resource, DomainResource, and per-resource StructureDefinition files with explicit baseDefinition inheritance.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini registers Resource and DomainResource as active abstract infrastructure resources and registers concrete resources such as Patient in the active resource list. Resource defines id, meta, implicitRules, and language; DomainResource defines text, contained, extension, and modifierExtension; Patient derives from DomainResource. The current build Patient JSON snapshot contains those inherited elements. Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later conflicting decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because the applied issue is satisfied by the current inheritance-based source model and generated snapshots. Duplicating common elements into each resource differential would be inconsistent with current StructureDefinition source conventions.
